summary_1line: Rama visits the sage Sutikshna, who joyfully welcomes him, offers the fruits of his ascetic merit, and invites Rama to reside in his peaceful hermitage.

image_candidates.scene_text: The dust-covered sage Sutikshna with matted hair rises from lotus posture and embraces Rama in his forest hermitage.
Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana walk through a dense flowering forest toward a garland-decorated hermitage deep in the wilderness.
Sutikshna offers the spiritual fruits of his austerities to Rama while standing before the simple bark-covered hermitage.
